sports.headline: Manchester United sack Carrick as Pochettino deal is agreed
sports.summary: Insider Sport's 'Sideline Moves' column reports that Manchester United have sacked Michael Carrick and agreed a deal for Mauricio Pochettino to take over. This is a headline-level report. I could not open the full article and the club had not confirmed the move in the sources I found.

sports.headline: Andreeva beats Pegula to become first teenager in a WTA Finals final since 2004
sports.summary: Mirra Andreeva, 19, beat Jessica Pegula 6-3 6-4 at Indian Wells and has not dropped a set in the tournament. The match followed Pegula being caught on a hot mic calling her a 'diva'. She will face Elina Svitolina in Sunday's final, after Svitolina beat Linda Noskova 6-2 6-1.

sports.headline: NBA names Fanatics Studios creative and event production partner for All-Star
sports.summary: The NBA and Fanatics Studios, a joint venture between Fanatics and OBB, announced a multiyear collaboration. Fanatics Studios will handle in-arena events, competitions and original content, starting with NBA All-Star 2027 in Phoenix.

fashion.headline: Frasers installs David Epstein as Hugo Boss CEO as Daniel Grieder steps down
fashion.summary: Frasers Group's chief brand partnerships officer David Epstein will become Hugo Boss CEO on 1 January 2027, succeeding Daniel Grieder, who leaves on 31 December. Frasers took majority control in October, and the German group recently cut its 2026 outlook. Reuters broke the story on 12 November.

fashion.headline: P. Johnson names ex-Ferragamo marketing chief Cliff Fleiser as CMO
fashion.summary: The Australian tailoring house has appointed Cliff Fleiser, previously SVP marketing and communications North America at Ferragamo, as chief marketing officer. He will report to founder and CEO Patrick Johnson. The role brings brand, PR, events, digital and CRM under one remit.

marketing.headline: Borussia Dortmund will not renew controversial Rheinmetall sponsorship
marketing.summary: Dortmund chairman Carsten Cramer said the club will not extend the arms manufacturer's deal beyond its 30 June 2027 expiry. Fans have criticised the deal since it began, and it was reportedly worth up to €9m a year. The club will lose that income from summer 2027.

marketing.headline: Omnicom Media lands Lufthansa Group's global media account
marketing.summary: B&T's 14 November newsletter reports Omnicom Media has won Lufthansa Group's global media account. This is a headline-level report, and the newsletter is the only source I found.
